- Lowered `MIN_SPAN_MS` to 45 ms and protected brief `CLOSED` spans in [visemeMap.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/core/visemeMap.ts).
- Added articulation and closure regression tests in [timeline.test.ts](C:/Users/nolan/talking-face/src/core/timeline.test.ts).
